## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally
- [ ] New code paths have tests, error paths included
- [ ] New strings are in `values/`, `values-el/` and `values-en/`
- [ ] A schema change has a migration and a `MigrationTest` case
- [ ] `make codemap` run if declarations were added, moved or renamed
- [ ] Release: `make bump` committed with release notes, or left for the maintainer, or the
      pull request ships no release (docs, CI or scripts only)
